description: Fiber 3 on fasthttp with prefork for multi-core scaling: one child process per core, each accepting on its own SO_REUSEPORT socket on 8080 and on the TLS listener alike, and the Postgres budget divided across them. Routing and typed path/query binding through the Fiber API, JSON via c.JSON, gzip and brotli through the Fiber compress middleware. Static files are read from disk per request, taking the pre-compressed .br/.gz twin the harness ships beside each file when the client accepts one. SIGTERM drains through ListenConfig.GracefulContext.
